_note: Wires for the Global Wire on forced labour, modern slavery, trafficking and child labour. harvest_slavery.py reads this and writes wire_slavery.json. Each wire carries a 'standing': official (UN bodies, courts, state agencies), labour (anti-slavery organisations, unions and worker groups), research (rights research), field (investigative and field press), or press. 'direct' and 'events' are the anti-slavery map's WIRE_FEEDS, with four bodies-and-courts wires the Indigenous feed already reads and a few site searches added; each carried Google News query keeps its old name in 'was'. 'gnews' asks the same subject in 24 languages, in the country editions the Indigenous feed uses, split into slices so no single search hits Google News's ~100-result cap.
